Repair The Cruncher with the toothed cog and eliminate the [[Rebel Spirit Keeper]]s.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* [[Summit Slaves]] active in quest log.

===Objectives===
* Place the toothed cog in The Cruncher's cog mouth. It is the only place a master gear won't fit.
* Eliminate the [5...0] remaining rebel spirit keepers.
* See Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Take a [[Master Gear]] from a nearby working [[Gearbox]], and use it on the gearbox by the gate south-east of Krak Flamewhip to open it. Follow the quest marker into the cavern beyond.

Kill the [[Rebel Spirit Keeper]]s until one drops the [[Toothed Cog]] and activate the proper gearbox indicated by the quest marker (the only one with square looking gears). Although the Rebel Spirit Keepers are not linked to any of the nearby Dredge groups, [[aggro]]ing the [[patrol]]ling additional Dredge is very likely.

Return to Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

=== Skill recommendations ===
* Rebel Spirit Keepers use [[Resurrect (monster skill)]] (8 second cast time, no recharge). Disabling this skill, either via [[Frozen Soil]] or interrupts (preferably using interrupts which also disable the skill, such as [[Distracting Shot]]) will make the Dredge groups easier to handle.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Krak Flamewhip
:''"There's been some trouble with our best pulverizer, '''The Cruncher'''. Some of those damned Dredge rebels managed to steal the '''toothed cog''' needed to operate that machine. Of all the machines to mess with! We can't meet our quota without The Cruncher! A master gear won't get 'er up 'n running; it must be that toothed cog. Get it back, fix The Cruncher, and take care o' any [[Dredge]] ye find. And be quick about it, or it'll be fifty lashes for ye!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Right away, Boss! Those rebel spirit keepers are as good as dead.

| ask = Ye better go retrieve that '''gear''', and quickly, before I decide to see if ye fit into the gear well!
}}

;Krak Flamewhip

==Notes==
* Sorrow's Belly can be scouted for [[Summit Slaves]] while fighting the Dredge.

==Trivia==
* The quest name is similar to the saying "[[wiktionary:throw a spanner in the works|throw a spanner (wrench) in the works (mechanism or machine)]]".
